checks: python3 tools/context_budget.py --strict (must exit 0; fix what it reports)
sessionReset.pushRule: commit with an English message and push to main; stage only this session's files; never commit .env, token.json, client_secret.json or any media file (video, images, audio, PSD, exports live on Google Drive); never push anything that uploads, schedules or makes a video public without the owner's approval (tools/approval.py check) and "publica"
recapSteps: git pull --rebase; update {handoff} (overwrite its Checkpoint block, under 12 lines, each line under 40 words: only what is pending (next step, owner approvals, open questions, blockers); decisions go to {decisions}, never to the checkpoint); add new rows to {decisions}; update CLAUDE.md, README.md and the rules or skills this session changed (a gotcha that came back goes to CLAUDE.md "Gotchas"); record new files in the README.md map and new tools in docs/tools.md;
if clips, videos or uploads changed, list their status (video id, rights, approval, privacy, slot) in the checkpoint;
sessionReset.restartPrompt: The conversation was cleared after the recap. Use the session start context (CLAUDE.md and the {handoff} checkpoint are already loaded); read nothing else now, unless the checkpoint is missing (then the Checkpoint block of {handoff}). Then summarize in {chatLanguage}, in 3 to 5 lines, where the work stands and what comes next, and wait for the task. Before the first edit of a task, grep {decisions} for its keywords.
